trust_stores.description: Comma-separated list of trust stores to install the local root CA into. Options are 'system', 'java' and 'nss'.

caroot.description: Custom directory path for the CA certificate and key storage location.

certificate_names.description: List of domain names, IP addresses, or email addresses to include in the certificate.

cert_file.description: Custom filename for the generated certificate.

key_file.description: Custom filename for the generated private key.

p12_file.description: Custom filename for the generated PKCS#12 file. Empty string disables PKCS#12 generation.

client_auth.description: If true, generate a certificate for client authentication (-client flag).

ecdsa.description: If true, generate a certificate with an ECDSA key (-ecdsa flag).
